sentences.en: Conclusion The efficacy of hemostasis is satisfactory by gastroscopic spraying Yunnan powder combined with Lansoprazole capsules mixed with normal saline in the peptic ulcer bleeding foci.

sentences.en: Methods Adopt double-pole electric-coagulative hemostasis, combine order method with retrograde method in minichclecystectomy.
